title: Young woman killed after attempted rape at gym in Londrina
seoTitle: Woman killed in attempted rape at Londrina gym
subtitle: Suspect Gabriel de Andrade charged with attempted rape and femicide
excerpt: Civil police concluded that Gabriel de Andrade premeditated the murder of 21-year-old Thaissa after attempting to rape her at a gym in Londrina.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: G1, Folha de S.Paulo, CNN Brasil
contentHtml:
Thaissa de Oliveira Marques, 21, was stabbed to death while working to promote a gym that was preparing to open in Londrina, northern Paraná. The suspect, Gabriel de Andrade, also 21, confessed to the crime and was indicted for attempted rape and femicide.

Civil police investigation

The Paraná Civil Police concluded the investigation this Monday (21) and pointed out that Gabriel visited the gym three days before the murder, claiming he wanted to see the place. Audio recordings by the victim show her discomfort with the suspect's constant visits.

Public Prosecutor's charges

The Paraná Public Prosecutor's Office filed charges for the crimes of attempted rape and femicide, with aggravating circumstances for cruel means and resources that hindered the victim's defense. The charges were sent to the State Court, which must determine if the accused will stand trial before a jury.

Victim profile and circumstances of the crime

Thaissa studied nutrition at UniFil and worked handing out flyers in front of the gym. On September 11, when approached by the suspect, she tried to flee but was caught and stabbed 44 times. Police found the knife and rope used in the crime inside the establishment, indicating planning.

Judicial reaction and next stage

Gabriel de Andrade has been in custody since September 11. The defense stated they will analyze the conclusion of the investigation before making a statement. If the charges are accepted, the case will proceed to trial, where evidence will be the decisive element.

Elements characterizing femicide

Prosecutors highlighted the use of cruel means—multiple stab wounds—and methods that hindered the victim's defense, such as the rope used to restrain her. These factors justify the increased penalty provided by law for qualified femicide.

With information from G1, Folha de S.Paulo, CNN Brasil.
